name: cc-mods
description: Custom Claude Code mods, a vendored example from anthropics/claude-code-playground, and pinned releases of mods from other repos.

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: An IDE-style file tree pane with git status, lines changed, and a shimmer on the files Claude reads and writes. Pinned to an upstream release. Needs Claude Code 2.1.306+.

plugins.name: token-weather
plugins.description: A live forecast of the context window, drawn above the prompt.

plugins.name: work-band
plugins.description: A one-line band above the prompt: the superpowers stage, another skill or Claude's to-do progress, the last test run, the request's time, and how many subagents are running. Comes back on resume.
